chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan, from Sayf ibn 'Umaira, from Mansur ibn Jabir, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

One who recites Surah al-Muzzammil in the Isha prayer or during the last part of the night, the night and the day will bear witness for him along with Surah al-Muzzammil, and Allah will grant him a pure life and a pure death.

key_terms.آخِرُ اللَّيْلِ: The last part of the night, a time of spiritual significance
key_terms.سُورَةُ الْمُزَّمِّلِ: Surah al-Muzzammil (The Enshrouded One), the 73rd chapter of the Quran
key_terms.شَاهِدَيْنِ: Two witnesses, referring to the night and day testifying for the reciter

ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual benefits of reciting Surah al-Muzzammil at night?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq emphasizes the transformative power of night prayer (Tahajjud) by linking the recitation of Surah al-Muzzammil to divine witness and spiritual purity. The promise of a 'good life' (Hayah Tayyibah) and 'good death' (Mawt Tayyibah) reflects the concept of dying in a state of spiritual readiness, a key theme in Twelver eschatology. This practice is historically associated with the Imams' emphasis on nocturnal devotion as a means of drawing closer to Allah during the quiet hours.
